title: Worker action schema and scope reconciliation
goal: Review archived worker-action SQL, add a safe active additive migration, and prove staging schema and authorization before WORK-006 enables actions

in: Reconcile archived local_only_unapplied worker-action SQL with active migrations and the hosted migration ledger.
Author an additive active migration for check-in and acknowledgement tables/policies only after event/tour/audience, event identity, and staff-shift reference review.
Validate owner, wrong-worker, foreign-org, and unrelated event/tour denial in isolated staging.
out: Apply archived SQL blindly or replay migrations automatically.
Enable FEATURE_WORK_MODE_WORKER_ACTIONS or change worker UI; WORK-006 owns that staged handoff.
Reset, truncate, delete, or alter production data.

acceptance_criteria: The worker-action schema is represented by reviewed, additive active migration(s), with no archived SQL applied blindly.
RLS and grants enforce user, assignment, organization, event/tour, and publication audience scope as appropriate.
Hosted staging ledger and schema parity are recorded against the exact deployed SHA.
Denial probes cover wrong worker, wrong organization, unrelated event/tour, and packet audience; allowed action and retry paths are verified.
WORK-006 receives postflight evidence before its feature flag can be enabled.
